title: Weekly Quality Meeting
scene: Mia 主持每週品質會議，Tom 報告上週的狀況。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started. Tom, could you go over last week's numbers first?
lines.zh: 早安各位，我們開始吧。Tom，可以先幫大家過一下上週的數字嗎？

lines.en: Sure. Our defect rate went down from two percent to one point five percent.
lines.zh: 好的。我們的不良率從百分之二降到百分之一點五。

lines.en: That's good news. What do you think made the difference?
lines.zh: 這是好消息。你覺得是什麼帶來改變？

lines.en: We changed the inspection steps on Line B, so we catch problems earlier now.
lines.zh: 我們改了 B 線的檢驗步驟，所以現在能更早抓到問題。

lines.en: Great. Are we still on track for the customer audit next month?
lines.zh: 很好。下個月的客戶稽核，我們的進度還正常嗎？

lines.en: Mostly, yes. But we're a little behind on the training records.
lines.zh: 大致上是。但教育訓練紀錄有點落後。

lines.en: How far behind are we?
lines.zh: 落後多少？

lines.en: About a week. Some new operators haven't finished their training yet.
lines.zh: 大約一週。有些新進作業員還沒完成訓練。

lines.en: OK. Could you send me a list of the people who still need training?
lines.zh: 好。你可以把還需要訓練的人員名單寄給我嗎？

lines.en: No problem. I'll send it to you by this afternoon.
lines.zh: 沒問題。我今天下午前寄給你。

lines.en: Thanks. Next, let's talk about the customer complaint from last Thursday.
lines.zh: 謝謝。接下來談上週四的客訴。

lines.en: Right. The customer found scratches on some of the boards in their shipment.
lines.zh: 對。客戶在收到的貨裡，發現有些板子有刮傷。

lines.en: How many boards were affected?
lines.zh: 有多少片受影響？

lines.en: Twelve out of five hundred.
lines.zh: 五百片裡有十二片。

lines.en: Do we know what caused the scratches?
lines.zh: 知道刮傷的原因嗎？

lines.en: We think it happened during packing. The trays were not cleaned properly.
lines.zh: 我們認為是包裝時發生的。托盤沒有清潔乾淨。

lines.en: I see. Have we replied to the customer yet?
lines.zh: 了解。我們回覆客戶了嗎？

lines.en: Not yet. I'm thinking of sending them a first report tomorrow.
lines.zh: 還沒。我在想明天先寄一份初步報告給他們。

lines.en: Good. Could you include some photos and the next steps in the report?
lines.zh: 好。報告裡可以附上一些照片和後續步驟嗎？

lines.en: Sure. I'll also explain how we're going to stop it from happening again.
lines.zh: 好。我也會說明我們要怎麼防止再發生。

lines.en: Perfect. Customers always want to know that part.
lines.zh: 很好。客戶都很想知道這部分。

lines.en: Should I copy you on the email?
lines.zh: 寄信時要副本給你嗎？

lines.en: Yes, please. And let's follow up on this in next week's meeting.
lines.zh: 要，麻煩了。我們下週會議再追蹤這件事。

lines.en: Got it.
lines.zh: 了解。

lines.en: One last thing. The new measuring machine arrives on Friday.
lines.zh: 最後一件事。新的量測機台週五到。

lines.en: Oh, finally! Who's going to set it up?
lines.zh: 喔，終於！誰要負責架設？

lines.en: The supplier will send an engineer. Could you work with him on Friday afternoon?
lines.zh: 供應商會派一位工程師來。你週五下午可以跟他一起作業嗎？

lines.en: Friday afternoon works for me. I'll prepare the test samples before he arrives.
lines.zh: 週五下午我可以。我會在他來之前準備好測試樣品。

lines.en: Great, thank you. That's everything for today. Does anyone have any questions?
lines.zh: 太好了，謝謝。今天就這些。大家有問題嗎？

lines.en: No, I think we covered everything.
lines.zh: 沒有，我想我們都談到了。

lines.en: OK. Thanks, everyone. Have a good week, and see you next Monday.
lines.zh: 好。謝謝大家。祝大家這週順利，下週一見。

quiz.q: What happened to the defect rate?
options: It went up to two percent.
It went down to one point five percent.
It went down to one percent.
quiz.why: Tom 說不良率從 2% 降到 1.5%。

quiz.q: What caused the scratches on the boards?
options: The new machine on Line B
quiz.why: It happened during packing. The trays were not cleaned properly.

quiz.q: When will Tom work with the supplier's engineer?

words.ex1: Tom, could you go over last week's numbers first?
words.ex2: Let's go over the inspection results before the meeting.
words.ex2zh: 開會前我們先把檢驗結果過一遍。

words.ex1: Are we still on track for the customer audit next month?
words.ex2: The project is on track to finish by the end of the month.
words.ex2zh: 專案進度正常，月底可以完成。

words.ex1: And let's follow up on this in next week's meeting.
words.ex2: I'll follow up on the customer's request tomorrow.
words.ex2zh: 我明天會追蹤客戶的要求。

words.ex1: Our defect rate went down from two percent to one point five percent.
words.ex2: We found a small defect on the surface of the board.
words.ex2zh: 我們在板子表面發現一個小瑕疵。

words.ex1: The customer found scratches on some of the boards in their shipment.
words.ex2: The next shipment will leave the factory on Monday.
words.ex2zh: 下一批貨會在星期一出廠。

speaking.patternZh: 可以請你……嗎？（禮貌地請別人幫忙）

reorder.zh: 你可以把還需要訓練的人員名單寄給我嗎？
報告裡可以附上一些照片和後續步驟嗎？
你可以在明天之前回覆客戶嗎？

part2.q: Where should I put the inspection report?
part2.why: 問 Where（哪裡），要回答地點。B 重複了 inspect 這個字，是陷阱。

part2.q: How long will the audit take?
part2.why: How long 問「多久」，要回答時間長度。C 用了 long，是陷阱。

part2.q: Would you like me to call the supplier?
part2.why: Would you like me to... 是「要不要我幫你……」，回答接受或拒絕最自然。
part2.zh: 要我打電話給供應商嗎？

part2.q: Why don't we meet on Thursday instead?
part2.why: Why don't we... 是「我們何不……」的建議，不是問原因，所以不用 Because 回答。
part2.zh: 我們何不改成星期四開會？

part2.q: Which machine needs to be repaired?
opts: The one next to the window.
part2.why: Which 問「哪一個」，要指出是哪一台。B 重複了 repair，是陷阱。
